scripts.build: (npm run --silent pipelines -- installed .pipelines || npm ci --prefix .pipelines --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund --silent) && (npm run --silent pipelines -- installed || npm ci --ignore-scripts) && npm run --silent pipelines -- build
